calibration.note: Raw scores come from a model trained on subsampled negatives, so they are not probabilities; isotonic regression on the calibration split maps them to probabilities. Equal-mass bins.

forecast.workload_definition: alerts per hour whose score clears the α=0.05 pooled conformal threshold

gates.rule: lower bound of the test-split F1 95% interval ≥ limit
champion F1 interval lies entirely above the rules incumbent's
standard deviation of test F1 across training seeds ≤ limit
expected calibration error after isotonic, held-out split ≤ limit
with shuffled labels, test PR-AUC ÷ base rate ≤ limit (no learnable leakage)
share of monitored features with major PSI drift on any day of ≥ 1000 rows ≤ limit (no assessable day fails the gate)
every typology with ≥ 20 test positives has recall measured
